overview: White gets a space advantage and a central pawn majority after 4.Nc3 exd5 5.cxd5 d6, with e4-e5 as the big threat. Black has a queenside pawn majority and counterplay with ...g6, ...Bg7, ...O-O and ...b5, with the knight reaching d7 and c5. The result is unbalanced: White attacks in the centre and on the kingside, Black on the queenside and along the long diagonal.

white_ideas.idea: Push e4 and e5 to break open the centre using the space advantage
Fianchetto or play Bd3, Nf3, h3 and Bf4 with a solid centre
Stop Black's ...b5 and ...Nbd7-c5 counterplay with a3, a4 and Nd2

black_ideas.idea: Queenside majority play with ...a6 and ...b5 against White's c-file
Pressure the e5 square, long diagonal bishop on g7 and the e-file

typical_structures.structure: Benoni structure: White d5/e4 against Black c5/d6, with half-open e-file for Black and a queenside majority
White's central pawn majority against Black's queenside majority

character.notes: Asymmetric, high risk for both sides; White's e5 break and Black's queenside play lead to forcing, dynamic games and Black can be squeezed.

gambit.notes: No pawn is given, though 4...b5 Benko is a different branch.

soundness.notes: Sound, though Black can be squeezed with accurate play.

structure.notes: Fixed asymmetric centre with a half-open e-file for Black and c-file for White, so Semi-open.

approach.notes: Standard repertoire opening for Black against 1.d4.

level.notes: Known to need detailed theory against the Taimanov Attack (f4/Bb5) and Black plans are hard to get right.

sublines_that_differ.name: Taimanov Attack
sublines_that_differ.how: White goes for a direct central and kingside attack, making the game much sharper.

sublines_that_differ.name: Fianchetto Variation
sublines_that_differ.how: Slower, with White solid and Black aiming for queenside play.

character.reason: Unbalanced structure where Black can be squeezed or counter-attack, one wrong move can lose fast.

gambit.reason: No pawn is sacrificed in the main line.

soundness.reason: A main-line defence at club and master level.

structure.reason: Fixed asymmetric centre pressed along half-open files.

level.reason: Sharp theory against Taimanov and Black plans are hard to get right.

plans.reason: White space and e5 break against Black's queenside majority.
